title: StructuredRadiologyReportSchema
description: JSON schema for structured radiology reports generated from the Evidence Layer.

study_id.description: Identifier of the imaging study (e.g., CXR1122).

image_id.description: Identifier of the specific radiograph (e.g., CXR1122_IM-0080-1001-0002).

findings.description: List of structured finding statements generated strictly from input evidence.

finding.description: Standardized name of the radiological finding.

statement.description: Clear clinical descriptive sentence for the FINDINGS section.

location.description: Location (must match input evidence or remain 'unspecified').

severity.description: Severity (must match input evidence or remain 'unspecified').

impression.description: List of concise diagnostic summary points for the IMPRESSION section.
